title: Keep the Window Open

mood.label: Uneasy
mood.summary: Strikes traded between Sanaa and Aramco kept the Gulf heaviest, cholera surged in Yemen and a missile darkened a Kyiv power plant. Brent held near $106. Small openings: a peace window in DR Congo, a Colombian tribunal, and the first new drug in 30 years for a deadly brain disease.

lines: Sanaa burns, and then Aramco answers,
the sirens trade their lines across the sea.
In Yemen the water carries fever,
Kyiv goes dark with no warning on the screen.
Five lost to the Mexico rain,
a train lies down in Pakistan.
Singapore counts what the chips began.
There's a window, someone says, in the Congo,
an old wrong finally named in Bogotá's light.
Thirty years to find one cure —
